newsitem.title: THAILAND: U.N. takes steps to improve air cargo movement.
newsitem.headline: U.N. takes steps to improve air cargo movement.

text.p: The U.N. Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP) said on Thursday it planned to recommend measures to streamline the movement of air cargo in the region.
Bangkok-based ESCAP said in a statement it would recommend proposals to cut transaction time and cost as well as the balancing of import and export of air cargo in the region.
It said the measures would be discussed at a meeting of the steering group of the Committee for Regional Economic Cooperation to be held in Japan between February 4 and 6.
The steering group is a policy-level think-tank, established by ESCAP, to promote and strengthen regional economic cooperation in Asia and the Pacific.
ESCAP said the meeting would focus on regional economic cooperation for enhancing trade in the context of air cargo movement and the spread of electronic commerce in Asia and the Pacific.
